name: Folk Painting of the World
subtitle: Rosemaling, Madhubani & more
shortDescription: 8 folk painting traditions to play: Rosemaling, Madhubani painting, Petrykivka painting and Tingatinga painting.
longDescription:
Folk Painting of the World: 8 folk painting traditions from 6 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Rosemaling, Madhubani painting, Petrykivka painting, Tingatinga painting, Kalamkari pen painting, Kashmiri papier-mache painting, Luk chup and Pysanka.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can make traditional crafts, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
